sections.label: TOOL CALL: python
sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def state(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    out={}
    for name,pat in [('R','R'),('b','b'),('N','N')]:
        cells=[(i,j) for i in range(55) for j in range(64) if a[i][j]==pat]
        out[name]=(min(r for r,c in cells),max(r for r,c in cells),min(c for r,c in cells),max(c for r,c in cells)) if cells else None
    m=[(i,j) for i in range(55) for j in range(64) if a[i][j]=='M']
    out['M']=(min(r for r,c in m),max(r for r,c in m),min(c for r,c in m),max(c for r,c in m))
    g=[(i,j) for i in range(55) for j in range(64) if a[i][j] in 'wg' and j>=14]
    out['beam']=(min(r for r,c in g),max(r for r,c in g),min(c for r,c in g),max(c for r,c in g)) if g else None
    return out
print('start:',state(current_frame))
for k in range(4):
    action(['LEFT'])
    s=state(current_frame)
    print(f'LEFT {k+1}:',s,'res:',last_action_result.get('board_changed'),last_action_result.get('level_completed'),last_action_result.get('done'))
    if last_action_result.get('level_completed') or last_action_result.get('done'): break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

def state(fr):
    a=fr.ascii.split('\n')
    out={}
    for name,pat in [('R','R'),('b','b'),('N','N')]:
        cells=[(i,j) for i in range(55) for j in range(64) if a[i][j]==pat]
        out[name]=(min(r for r,c in cells),max(r for r,c in cells),min(c for r,c in cells),max(c for r,c in cells)) if cells else None
    m=[(i,j) for i in range(55) for j in range(64) if a[i][j]=='M']
    out['M']=(min(r for r,c in m),max(r for r,c in m),min(c for r,c in m),max(c for r,c in m))
    g=[(i,j) for i in range(55) for j in range(64) if a[i][j] in 'wg' and j>=14]
    out['beam']=(min(r for r,c in g),max(r for r,c in g),min(c for r,c in g),max(c for r,c in g)) if g else None
    return out
